notes: ROUND 9 CALIBRATION: Confidence ~90% that all P0-P2 correctness bugs have been found. Main residual uncertainty: (1) Email/set create path -- build_email_from_create validates body structure but the actual bodyValues/partId resolution is delegated to the backend; did not verify backends correctly link bodyValues entries to their blob parts. (2) Space/join invite-code path also increments uses BEFORE checking already_member -- if the join fails (already_member), the uses counter was already incremented. This is a P1 correctness bug (invite use wasted on already-member request). (3) handle_email_copy: the create Map is iterated by borrow (&create), forcing copy_id.clone() on every arm (6+ sites). This residual clone is unfixed.
title: Review: round 9 — jmap-server + jmap-chat-server + jmap-mail-server
